submit_package_to_pypi: run the submit script to build and upload a Python package to the default PyPI repository
submit_package_to_custom_repo: run the submit script with --repository flag to upload a package to a custom PyPI repository
build_binary_distribution: run the submit script with --bdist flag to generate a binary wheel distribution for the current OS
upload_with_gpg_signing: run the submit script with --identity flag to GPG sign files before uploading to PyPI
upload_with_credentials: run the submit script with --username and --password flags to authenticate with the PyPI repository
